marketing.aboutTitle: A place to write and connect ideas.
marketing.aboutIntro: Lekhan is a writing workspace for Markdown notes, linked pages, and the occasional shared draft.
marketing.aboutStoryLocal: Link notes as you write, use backlinks to return to the source, and search titles, tags, and page text.
marketing.aboutStoryCloud: Use the local workspace for your own notes. Open the cloud workspace when a page needs collaborators or a public link.
marketing.faqIntro: How importing, storage, sharing, and AI work in Lekhan.
marketing.transferAnswer: Lekhan imports Markdown notes and folders, including tags, wikilinks, YAML frontmatter, callouts, and supported images. Check the report for unresolved links and embeds kept as links.
marketing.storageAnswer: Local pages stay in the browser where you wrote them. Cloud pages are created or imported separately and sync through your account. Export a backup before clearing browser data.
marketing.sharingQuestion: Can I share a page without giving edit access?
marketing.sharingAnswer: Invite someone as a viewer, or turn on a public read-only link for a cloud page. You can turn the public link off from the share screen.
marketing.providerQuestion: What does the writing assistant share?
marketing.providerAnswer: The assistant sends your prompt to the provider you configure. It includes page content only when you choose to share it for that request.
marketing.exportQuestion: How do I take my pages with me?
marketing.exportAnswer: Download an individual page as Markdown. From the local workspace, export a ZIP of Markdown files organized by folder.
marketing.contactIntro: Tell us what you were trying to do and where you got stuck.
marketing.emailBody: For account access, privacy requests, or questions about early access.
marketing.githubBody: For bug reports and feature requests. Leave out private page content.
